Marcus / Elena —

Quick legal intake on the insurance exhibit: Redwood can agree to name Helios Cloud as Additional Insured on the General Liability policy, subject to the following (please confirm back):

- Additional Insured wording: "Helios Cloud, its parent and subsidiary entities, and their respective officers, directors, employees and agents" (we need this exact phrasing for downstream ops).
- Insurer endorsement: we prefer CG 20 10 or equivalent broad form Additional Insured endorsement; insurer confirmation letter is acceptable if the actual endorsement will be furnished upon request.
- Waiver of subrogation: acceptable if carrier confirms in writing (carrier letter is fine).
- Limits: GL 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate; Cyber/Tech E&O: 2M; Umbrella: 5M. If Helios requires higher limits, please indicate in writing and we will engage underwriter.

Please include the following on the COI: named insured, policy numbers, effective/expiration dates, limits, and the Additional Insured wording above. If possible, have the broker/career provide a sample endorsement PDF (scanned) or a carrier-signed letter that references the endorsement form.

I'll review the carrier letter and sample COI when provided and confirm acceptance or note any required tweaks. For clarity, please route evidence to legal@redwoodinference.com (cc Marcus & David).
